name: Gearworks
desc:
Welcome to Gearworks — a mechanical engineering and computer science sandbox. 

Gearworks is a non-profit complete remaster of Defaultio's "Metalworks Sandbox Demo" with the sole intention of expanding upon his original concept. It's important to note that this project is a solo endeavor and is still under ongoing development. With that being said, there's still a lot more to come, including new components, features, gameplay enhancements, and even a new map.
